gaps.sentence: The museum ___ (close) to the public on Mondays.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: is + closed. No agent needed; the routine is what matters.

gaps.sentence: The letters ___ while the family was on holiday.
gaps.explanation: Ongoing during the holiday: past continuous passive were being + opened.

gaps.sentence: The match ___ (abandon) because of the storm, so we got a refund.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive with have to: had to be + past participle for past obligation.

gaps.sentence: She had her laptop ___ (repair) after the coffee spill.
gaps.explanation: Causative structure: had + her laptop + repaired. A technician performed the repair.

gaps.sentence: The winners ___ (GIVE) their medals by the mayor last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night' + agent 'by the mayor': past simple passive were given.

gaps.sentence: The recipe ___ (pass down) from generation to generation.
gaps.hint: continuing relevance from past to now
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: has been + passed down; the process links past and present.

gaps.sentence: The painting is believed ___ (steal) by an organised gang.
gaps.explanation: The theft preceded the believing: is believed to have been + stolen.

gaps.sentence: The divers ___ (know) to have been working without insurance.
gaps.explanation: are known to have been working: the knowing is present, the working was ongoing before.
